import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (dx - 1, 0, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            o = out(h)
            res.append(torch.flip(o, dims=[3]))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "gamma": 0.97, "lr": 0.001}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 48
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
NBLOCKS = 3


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (dx - 1, 0, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            o = out(h)
            res.append(torch.flip(o, dims=[3]))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(NBLOCKS - 1)])
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        f = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        for blk in self.blocks:
            f = F.relu(f + blk(f))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)

    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "gamma": 0.97, "lr": 0.001, "ppo_epochs": 2}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (dx - 1, 0, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            o = out(h)
            res.append(torch.flip(o, dims=[3]))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch

import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
GDIM = 64


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid, gdim):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.gproj = nn.Linear(gdim, proj)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f, g):
        p = self.proj(f) + self.gproj(g)[:, :, None, None]
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (dx - 1, 0, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            o = out(h)
            res.append(torch.flip(o, dims=[3]))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID, GDIM)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, GDIM), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GDIM, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GDIM, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        place = self.head(f, g)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "gamma": 0.97, "lr": 0.001, "ppo_epochs": 2}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
GDIM = 64


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid, gdim):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.gproj = nn.Linear(gdim, proj)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f, g):
        p = self.proj(f) + self.gproj(g)[:, :, None, None]
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (dx - 1, 0, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            o = out(h)
            res.append(torch.flip(o, dims=[3]))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID, GDIM)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, GDIM), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GDIM, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GDIM, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        place = self.head(f, g)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "lr": 0.001, "ppo_epochs": 2}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (dx - 1, 0, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            o = out(h)
            res.append(torch.flip(o, dims=[3]))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: The baseline scored 0 because its policy collapsed to DONE on the first step. The untrained trace shows why: the action's column index is mirrored. Every placement at anchor column x actually filled columns X-dx-x .. X-1-x. Rows and brick shapes behave as described. For example, a 1x1 aimed at column 2 filled column 5, and a 1x2 aimed at column 6 filled columns 0-1. The baseline's footprint-pooling head scores the window to the right of the anchor in the observation, so its logits point at the wrong cells. Every placement then looks costly, and DONE (reward 0) wins. The fix keeps the convolutional structure but pools the window to the left of each cell and then flips the logits along x. That is only a permutation after learned layers. Separately, the budget is only about 32 updates under the default recipe, so a recipe with more, smaller updates should help.
analyses.2: The starting network ended every episode with DONE because in this world the x axis of the action anchor is mirrored: action x fills columns X-dx-x to X-1-x. Lining the head up with that mirroring fixed it (r1c1, 0.713). Doubling the number of updates by halving n_envs and raising gamma to 0.97 gave the current best (r1c2, 0.872, seeds 0.91 and 0.83). That gap is bigger than the seed spread, so more, smaller updates look like they help. The deeper trunk (r1c3, 0.578) cost samples, and its seeds were far apart (0.39 and 0.77). Its errors were extra cells from stacking on the wrong column. With a budget this tight, samples and updates seem to matter more than network size. Every trial so far finished in about 50 s, so time is not a constraint. This round: (A) push the update count further; (B) swap PPO epochs for about twice as many samples; (C) a new idea, feeding global context into the local placement head.
analyses.3: This world flips the x axis of actions: action x fills columns X-dx-x to X-1-x. Every policy only learned after the head was mirrored to match (0 → 0.71). After that, the recipe mattered most. Twice as many updates (n_envs 128) gave 0.87. Halving envs again (r2c1) gave 0.89, within noise of that. Cutting PPO epochs from 4 to 2 (r2c2) nearly doubled the samples and gave 0.93, the current best. Adding global context to the head (r2c3) gave 0.91 at 4 epochs, which is +0.04 over its matched baseline r1c2. That gain is near seed noise, but both of its seeds were high (0.92, 0.90). A deeper trunk lost because it cost samples. The data so far point to samples and updates as the limit, not network capacity. Dev IoU is about 0.99, so the remaining failures are a few stray or out-of-order bricks. Next: combine global context with the cheaper recipes and test whether 1 epoch or more updates helps further.
analyses.4: Mirroring the head along x fixed the starting architecture's 0.0 result. Seed-0 traces confirm that action x fills columns X-dx-x to X-1-x. On top of that head, recipe changes mattered most. Doubling updates (r1c2, 0.87) beat the default recipe (0.71). Two PPO epochs (r2c2, 0.927) beat four. The global-context head (r2c3, 0.913) is within noise of the best. The main risk is training collapse. Early random placements earn negative reward while DONE earns 0, so some seeds learn to end every episode at once: one r3c1 seed and both r3c3 seeds. One epoch instead fell into using only 1x1 bricks. More aggressive updates seem to raise this risk: one epoch, or minibatches of 1,024 samples with two epochs. A deeper trunk lost too many samples. For this last round I keep r2c2 and change one thing in each candidate: more entropy against collapse and ruts, a longer horizon for the exact-build bonus, or three epochs.
